biotools.summary: Talindrew is a browser-based molecular biology workbench with its own MCP server. Edit DNA on circular and linear plasmid maps; simulate restriction, Gibson, Golden Gate, Gateway, TOPO/TA and In-Fusion cloning; plan whole strategies on an OpenCloning-compatible workspace (pydna engine, OpenCloning JSON in and out); design and score PCR primers; verify clones against AB1/SCF/ZTR Sanger traces; align up to 200 sequences; simulate digests and agarose gels; design CRISPR guides; translate, find ORFs and optimise codons; predict protein structures; screen ligands with the FoldRx fold-pocket-dock-ADMET pipeline; and record it all in an electronic lab notebook. The remote MCP server (https://mcp.talindrew.com/mcp) gives Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor and other AI assistants 90 of these tools. Opens SnapGene .dna, GenBank, FASTA, EMBL and ApE files. Free plan; nothing to install.
